title: Universal Android playback transport update
notes: Replaces the OkHttp-Media3 live transport with Android's native HTTP transport for compatibility with devices that can browse and download normally but time out on every stream. Required per-channel user-agent and referrer headers, cross-protocol redirects, the 20-second startup watchdog, bundled 25,398-channel playlist and guide are retained. Existing favourites, folders, settings, add-ons and logins are preserved.
